name: skillsmith
tagline_zh: 装技能像逛精品店，搜、比、装、管一步到位。还能查质量、防坑，让每个技能都物超所值。
tagline_en: Install skills like shopping curated goods—search, compare, manage, and vet quality. No more duds.
desc_en: Discover, install, compare, and manage Claude Code skills. Search the registry, get recommendations, validate skill quality, and manage your installed skills.
why_zh: 它不只会装，还能横向对比和质检，像买手帮你挑，避开那些看着炫但不好用的坑。
why_en: It doesn't just install—it compares and vets quality, like a curator who filters out shiny but useless skills.
